notes.title: Fixes for V1.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Since the release a few fixes and modification have been made in Relentless.

[h2]Modifications[/h2]
[list]
[*] Executive board votes are now more diverse
[*] Housebreaking event has been replace by a Disctrict Tax event
[*] Robbery event has been replace by an Exceptionnal Wealth Tax event
[*] Bar chart now have a progressive scale, it is no longuer by default showing a range from 0 to 100% of sector shares.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Lots of typography mistakes have been corrected
[*] Cyber-attack does not loop endlessly any longer
[*] text in final screen are now always visible
[*] Once the game is over you cannot reload it and keep going in a sort of endless run.
[/list]

If you run into an issue or have any suggestion, please contact us at contact@breakpoint-games.com.
